mapper.select: SELECT c.id, c.item_id, c.user_id, c.content, c.reply_id, c.created_at, u.nickname, u.avatar FROM cb_comment c LEFT JOIN cb_user u ON c.user_id = u.id WHERE c.id = #{id}

SELECT c.id, c.item_id, c.user_id, c.content, c.reply_id, c.created_at, u.nickname, u.avatar FROM cb_comment c LEFT JOIN cb_user u ON c.user_id = u.id WHERE c.item_id = #{itemId} ORDER BY c.created_at ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO cb_comment (item_id, user_id, content, reply_id, created_at) VALUES (#{itemId}, #{userId}, #{content}, #{replyId}, NOW())
